mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% (FEDFUNDS) indicates an extremely accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and increasing equity present value, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 235, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0% and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 900,000, it signals a tight labor market and strong housing demand, indicating economic resilience and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0% AND HOUST > 900, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
